_comment: Empty and constant-returning defaults from four base/UI classes, read out of
MM2_RE_KIT/GHIDRA_DECOMP and confirmed one instruction each in the binary.
?SetElasticity@phBound@@UAEMXZ, which return M with no arguments - they are getters, and
Ghidra shows `return;` because it dropped the x87 return value. Also cityLevel::GetWaterLevel,

Also excluded: uiWidget::Action and ::CaptureAction, which take an eqEvent BY VALUE. eqEvent has no recovered layout anywhere - forward-declared in six headers, defined in none - and a by-value parameter needs the complete type.
